progress.note: Progress percentage is estimated from optimization iterations reported as 'ITERATION n' by scMTNI (upper bound 100 iterations).

x.description: Maximum number of regulators considered per target gene.

p.description: Root prior probability that an edge exists in the lineage root cell type.

b.description: Sparsity prior (beta0). More negative values produce sparser networks.

q.description: Motif prior weight (beta1). Use 0 when motif prior is not available.

indep.description: If true, runs INDEP mode (single-cell-type version). If false, lineage_tree is required.

split_genes.description: If true, enables split-gene mode (-c yes) expected by the scMTNI preprocessing format.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr execution log from scMTNI.
Runtime helper inputs generated by the wrapper for scMTNI.
Raw per-cluster outputs generated by the scMTNI executable.
